# PDF archive prune, 2026-09-30

Houston approved deleting OUTDATED PDF versions to recover disk (~2 GB free). Latest version of each paper is retained everywhere it is served.

## Backup verification

- Every removed path below is git-tracked (not LFS) and its blob id is present in `origin/main` (Hubify-Projects/bigbounce on GitHub) at commit `0e09960dfc970dfba443db6f688932e0da063b32` (local HEAD == origin/main after fetch, worktree clean). The `git_blob` column is the blob id in that tree; restore with `git checkout 0e09960d -- <path>`.
- Backblaze B2 bucket `bigbounce` holds no PDF copies (aws s3 listing, 0 `.pdf` keys); not used as a backup target for this prune. GitHub + local `.git` history are the retained copies (2 locations, not 3).
- `pdf-archive/manifests/` (append-only JSON ledgers with sha256/md5/page counts for every version) is untouched, so every removed version remains identifiable.

## Kept (latest per paper)

pdf-archive: P1A v1A.0.127, P1B v2B.0.18 (newest archived; current served v2B.0.24 lives in public/papers), P2 v1.7.130 (x2 builds; current v1.7.131 is served only), P3 v3.2.0-r17 (x2 builds), P4 v1.0.274, P5 v0.1.147, all 5 P1-LEGACY documents. Served roots: newest versioned file per family plus unversioned aliases plus every version referenced by site/src data or root HTML. `site/out` (git-ignored Next export, rebuildable) deleted.
